_comment: Tier-2 for the three fix surf/temp claims in one deck. Ten variants run on the installed binary. cht:0 — the intuitive order (surf_collide before the fix) and a MISSING fix produce the SAME message, 'ERROR: Surf_collide tsurf could not find custom attribute (../surf_collide.cpp:141)', which is the entry's point: the diagnostic cannot tell you which mistake you made. cht:1 — a bare compute source, which is what the SPARTA doc page's own example passes, aborts with 'ERROR: Fix surf/temp compute does not compute per-surf vector (../fix_surf_temp.cpp:82)', and 'c_q[*]' aborts identically because the wildcard parses as index 0; 'c_q[1]' runs; a single-value fix ave/surf over-indexed as f_aq[1] gives 'ERROR: Fix surf/temp fix does not compute per-surf array (../fix_surf_temp.cpp:112)'. cht:2 — emissivity 0.0 and 1.5 both give 'ERROR: Fix surf/temp emissivity must be > 0.0 and <= 1 (../fix_surf_temp.cpp:125)' while 1.0 exactly is accepted. Every quoted message matched verbatim including the (file:line) suffix. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 with SPARTA (24 Sep 2025). MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 repairs every variant that is supposed to abort, one token each — the wrong-order deck puts the fix in front of the surf_collide, the 'missing fix' deck gets the fix, the bare 'c_q' and the wildcard 'c_q[*]' become 'c_q[1]', the over-indexed 'f_aq[1]' becomes 'f_aq', and the 0.0 and 1.5 emissivities become 0.9. All ten variants then exit rc=0 with no ERROR line. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES (rc=0); with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1) and these expect_in_output strings go False and disappear: every_quoted_fix_surf_temp_message_is_verbatim=True, doc_page_bare_compute_form_does_not_work=True, emissivity_zero_is_rejected_not_read_as_no_radiation=True. TWO ASSERTIONS SURVIVE THE REPAIR, and that is a finding rather than a pass: wrong_order_and_missing_fix_give_the_same_message and wildcard_index_fails_exactly_like_the_bare_form both compare errors(...)[:1] of two decks, and two EMPTY error lists compare equal, so both stay True the moment nothing aborts. As written each says 'these two decks fail the same way OR neither fails at all'. The fixture still goes red overall, on the verbatim check and the UNEXPECTED: lines, but neither of those two strings would on its own notice that the pathology was gone. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/sparta/fix_surf_temp_order_brackets_emissivity && python source.py (passes, rc=0), then T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py (fails, rc=1). Needs a SPARTA binary: the fixtures find spa_serial/spa_mpi on PATH or at ~/Schreibtisch/sparta/src/spa_serial, else set SPARTA_BINARY; with none present they exit 0 on a SKIP: line. This fixture also forbids SKIP:, so on a host without the binary it is reported FAIL rather than skipped.
